    C

    CausalBufferDeserializationException - Exception Class in io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley
    Thrown when a held record's key or value cannot be deserialised from the buffer store on the forward path (drain or propagate) — typically because the registry state for its subject changed after the record was buffered (e.g. the writer schema id was deleted, or a redeployed reader schema is incompatible).
    CausalClock - Class in io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley
    A vector clock (Fidge 1988; Mattern 1988, "Virtual Time and Global States of Distributed Systems") over causal coordinates: a set of (topic, partition) → offset entries, indexed by channel — the topic-partition — rather than by process, a stated variant of the classical form (Kafka's partition is the stable, durable axis a process identity is not).
    CausalClock.Builder - Class in io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley
    Builder for CausalClock.
    CausalCoordinateException - Exception Class in io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley
    A CausalDeliveryException anchored to a single source coordinate — the (topic, topicId, partition, offset) quartet identifying the record the failure is about, exposed for operator diagnostics.
    CausalDeliveryException - Exception Class in io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley
    Base of every exception Parsley's causal machinery throws out of a processing task.
    CausalPendingAckException - Exception Class in io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley
    Thrown by the crossing-wait primitive when a pending own-output acknowledgement times out, fails, or the wait is interrupted.
    CausalProcessedStream<K,V> - Class in io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley
    A causal stage bound to its processor, ready to declare sink(s) with CausalProcessedStream.to(String) and then terminate the topology with CausalProcessedStream.build().
    CausalStream<K,V> - Class in io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley
    One or more causal source topics, ready to feed a single causal-decorated processor with CausalStream.process(ProcessorSupplier).
    CausalStreams - Class in io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley
    The causal application runtime: a Facade (GoF) over the Kafka Streams instance a CausalTopology runs as, and the causal machinery a plain KafkaStreams doesn't know about — graceful causal drain on shutdown — behind the one simple start/close lifecycle below.
    CausalStreams(CausalTopology, Properties) - Constructor for class io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.CausalStreams
    Assembles topology into a real Kafka Streams topology and wraps a KafkaStreams instance over it.
    CausalStreamsBuilder - Class in io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley
    Builds a CausalTopology: exactly one causal stage — a set of source topics feeding a causal-decorated processor and forwarding to one or more sinks.
    CausalStreamsBuilder() - Constructor for class io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.CausalStreamsBuilder
     
    CausalTopicRecreatedException - Exception Class in io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley
    Thrown on the record and stamping paths once Parsley's topic-identity watch has detected that a causal topic was deleted (or deleted and recreated) while this member ran.
    CausalTopology - Class in io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley
    The immutable causal topology CausalProcessedStream.build() produces: the single declared stage's source topics, processor, sink(s), and partitioner.
    CausalVectorClockResolutionException - Exception Class in io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley
    Thrown at ingest when an inbound record's parsley-causal-clock header is present but cannot be decoded into a vector clock — a corrupt or truncated header, or one written in an unsupported wire version.
    close() - Method in class io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.CausalStreams
    Gracefully shuts down: waits — unbounded, no timeout — for every task's causal buffer to drain through the ordinary delivery path, then stops the underlying KafkaStreams.
    close() - Method in class io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.ParsleyOwnOutputInterceptor
     
    close(Duration) - Method in class io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.CausalStreams
    Gracefully shuts down within a time budget, for callers that cannot block unbounded — a JVM shutdown hook above all.
    configure(Map) - Method in class io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.ParsleyOwnOutputInterceptor

    isNullMessage(ConsumerRecord) - Static method in class io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.CausalClock

    M

    merge(CausalClock) - Method in class io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.CausalClock
    Returns the causal union of this clock and other — the per-coordinate maximum offset (the vector-clock join).
    merge(CausalStream) - Method in class io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.CausalStream
    Combines this stream's source topics with other's into one, so a later CausalStream.process(ProcessorSupplier) call fans every topic from both into the same causal stage.
    metrics() - Method in class io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.CausalStreams
    The underlying KafkaStreams instance's metrics, Parsley's own per-task sensors included (records buffered and released, deserialization and clock-resolution failures, ignored out-of-scope dependencies, and the rest of the parsley group) — the in-process way to reach them without going through JMX.

    O

    observe(ConsumerRecord) - Method in class io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.CausalClock
    Folds a consumed record into this clock and returns the result: the union of this clock, the clock record itself carried, and record's own position (topic, partition, offset).
    offset() - Method in exception class io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.CausalCoordinateException
    The record's offset on that partition.
    onAcknowledgement(RecordMetadata, Exception) - Method in class io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.ParsleyOwnOutputInterceptor
    Resolves a tracked send: folds a successful ack's committed coordinate into the registry's per-coordinate max, then clears its pending count (T2.1 — exactly one callback per send, abort included, failures carrying a non-null exception).
    onSend(ProducerRecord) - Method in class io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.ParsleyOwnOutputInterceptor
    Records a tracked send as pending and binds the sending thread — the producer's one owning stream thread under EOS v2 — to this producer's tracker, so the crossing wait can resolve "this task's pending sends" from the current thread.

    P

    ParsleyOwnOutputInterceptor - Class in io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley
    The producer-side half of the ownOutputs clock (D2): publishes every acknowledged send to a declared sink topic into this instance's ParsleyOwnOutputRegistry, from which the stream threads fold coordinates into ParsleyChannels.acknowledge(Uuid, int, long) before each stamp.
    ParsleyOwnOutputInterceptor() - Constructor for class io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.ParsleyOwnOutputInterceptor

    process(String, ProcessorSupplier) - Method in class io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.CausalStream
    As CausalStream.process(ProcessorSupplier), naming the stage explicitly — the name becomes the causal buffer store's namespace, so give it a stable, unique name across topology edits and restarts rather than relying on the auto-derived default.
    process(ProcessorSupplier) - Method in class io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.CausalStream

    W

    withPartitioner(StreamPartitioner) - Method in class io.github.tobyjamesclements.parsley.CausalProcessedStream
    Sets the StreamPartitioner applied to every sink this stage declares (default: Kafka's own key-hash partitioner) — never configurable per-sink, so two sinks in the same stage can never drift onto different partitioners.
